name: referenceresolver-write-and-type-sites
body: Collect marks only INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and MERGE targets as writes (an OUTPUT … INTO table counts as a read), takes type uses only from parameters, DECLARE variables and table, table-variable, temp-table and RETURNS-table columns (a CAST or CONVERT to a user-defined type gives no edge), and finds aliases only at the top level of a FROM clause and through its joins, not inside subqueries, as requirements.requirement.sql-uses-kind and requirements.requirement.sql-type-uses state the sites. Upgrade if OUTPUT INTO is to be a write, CAST/CONVERT targets are to be type uses, or subquery aliases can be write targets.
